kind: Independent pre-patch source and ownership review
reviewer: integration subagent; GPT-6 Astra Pro, inherited root reasoning level

findings.finding: Open-element, formatting and head/form pointers are borrowed. New detached incremental writes permit script-driven DOM removal between feed calls, which can free unwrapped elements still referenced by the parser.
findings.requirement: Keep explicit parser-owned holds through parser_free for every element used across feeds, including formatting reconstructions. Test removal between split writes.

findings.finding: template_content is an owning pointer whose fragment adopts an inert owner document; an attached shadow root is owned by a host in its own document.
findings.requirement: Use a distinct nonowning insertion redirect and explicitly retained host/root; do not alias template_content to a root under current free/adopt rules.

findings.finding: node_free_tree(host) resets shadow_root refcount to zero. Holding only the root does not preserve its host and can be invalidated by host release.
findings.requirement: Release parser holds in a proven safe order, clearing redirects and releasing root before host, or correct ownership accounting consistently. Test removed/unclosed nested hosts at parser and document teardown.

findings.finding: Document.open must not destroy the Document allocation or force clear refcounts/js on reachable old nodes.
findings.requirement: Free old write_parser first; detach old children with normal node_remove/node_free_tree semantics; safely reset retained target/selection/focus and html/head/body pointers.

findings.finding: Document cloning must copy declarative permission but never share an active owned parser.
findings.requirement: New clone parser starts null. Distinct documents may receive interleaved split writes without cross-contamination.

findings.finding: Detached Document.write parser feeds reach a global html_script_hook path.
findings.requirement: Verify the existing hook rejects inactive/detached documents or suppress it per parser. Do not execute detached scripts in the active page realm.

findings.finding: Document.write receives Unicode strings and must remain outside byte-response/BOM decoding.
findings.requirement: Preserve the accepted encoding policy and active-page behavior; validate relevant prior frame/JSON/BOM regressions.

normativeControls.facts: Document cloning retains its declarative permission. A clonable shadow root and its descendants are copied even when the host clone is shallow. Existing declarative roots permit matching-mode attachShadow reuse with content clearing; other reattachments fail.

Invalid or duplicate declarative hosts retain ordinary template behavior. The parser uses the current host and root mode/flags. Legacy innerHTML fragment parsing must not acquire permission from its document implicitly.

minimumFocusedControls: open clears while previously wrapped nodes remain safe
native live-node balance after repeated close/free
invalid host and mode retain template
matching-mode declarative reattachment and mismatched rejection
shallow/deep clone with and without clonable flag
document clone permission and independent stream state
requiredAcceptance: Actual guarded source review, genuine unchanged RED/GREEN, fresh immutable candidate build and all accepted source/WPT/resource gates; no new pass or broad DSD-completeness claim yet.

invariants: All four parser element creation paths retain borrowed stack entries until parser destruction.
Declarative templates use parser-private borrowed redirects, not template_content ownership aliases.
document.open retains the top-level ancestry of removed trees with any JS wrapper.
Adoption transfers matching retired-root list entries without changing retain counts.
All owned document write states are released before any document destructor; cleanup is idempotent.
js_free collects only zero-refcount parentless non-host roots, so cleanup of retained or parented trees does not invalidate that later roots vector.
finalSourceReview.requiredAcceptance: Fresh frozen37 functional GREEN, independent lifetime teardown, same-artifact existing755/custom controls, upstream WPT cohort and isolated resources.
finalSourceReview.limits: Source review does not establish full declarative shadow DOM, all cross-realm generic adoption lifetime behavior, or final artifact acceptance.

finalScopeDecision.acceptedScope: Detached HTML document streams and cloned document policy only; exact final candidate c259 remains subject to downstream gates.
finalScopeDecision.reason: Whole unmodified upstream ordinary-template fixture acquired a harness ERROR because eager native parsing precedes script/MutationObserver checkpoints.
finalScopeDecision.repair: Remove initial network/frame parser permission globally; retain actual HTML browsing-document clone policy at JsCtx creation. No test/host/URL exceptions.
finalScopeDecision.activeDocumentLimitation: jwrap assigns an owning frame realm prototype where owner_ctx exists; ordinary child-document writes keep their own realm historical active path. Borrowed foreign-realm methods are not generally solved.
